title: Ontario municipal systems that convert housing targets into completed units
question: Which municipal systems can convert housing targets into completed units?
why_it_matters: Provincial targets and housing demand matter only if municipal planning, servicing, approvals, infrastructure, labor, and financing can convert them into occupied homes.
current_support: FTFN has Ontario housing supply progress, CMHC housing data, Statistics Canada permits, Toronto AIC, and a selected Toronto application record: 24 254930 ESC 20 OZ for a proposed 578-unit mixed-use development.
candidate_records: Toronto application 24 254930 follow-up decision and status records
next_action: Track application 24 254930 through staff reports and decisions, then add servicing, building-permit, approval-timeline, start, and completion evidence.
notes: Phase 50B added the first named Toronto application record. The gap remains unresolved because an application does not prove approval, servicing, building permits, starts, completions, occupancy, or province-wide municipal performance.
